payload.body: A cleanup pass over the shipped table UI. The game math and trainer are correct; the surface is not yet good enough to look at. Each defect Jim names becomes a work item under this node, designed by the planning partner before implementation and verified live in a real browser at both breakpoints. First item done: the shoe-opening burn ritual (26t84eh1) — card anchored left and vertically centred, burned cards gridded beside it with a flick-in / gather-out motion.
